title: Nashville Best Whiskey Tasting Tour
includes: Distillery Tour with Tastings to immerse yourself in Tennessee whiskey
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the essence of Nashville's whiskey scene with a guided tour of three renowned distilleries: Corsair Distillery, Big Machine Distillery, and Nashville Barrel Company. 

This immersive 3-hour experience includes whiskey tastings at each location, providing a unique opportunity to savor both classic and adventurous spirits. 

Enjoy hassle-free round-trip transportation from downtown Nashville with a professional driver from Mint Julep Tours. Whether you're a whiskey novice or a seasoned enthusiast, this tour is tailored for everyone. End your afternoon ready to explore Nashville's vibrant nightlife, from live music to bustling honky-tonks.

- Visit three iconic Nashville distilleries with guided tastings
- Round-trip transportation from downtown Nashville included
- Professional driver and air-conditioned bus for comfort
- Perfect for groups, couples, or special occasions
